description: Rejuvenex Vega Shine is a Korean all-in-one injectable skinbooster that pairs c-PDRN (polydeoxyribonucleotide) with a brightening and antioxidant complex. It is positioned as a next-generation 'glow' booster that combines the hydration of water-glow injections with the regenerative action of PDRN in a single formula, delivered by intradermal microinjection or mesotherapy. The product is designed to improve radiance, even skin tone and restore oil-moisture balance.
howItWorks: The active complex is PDRN-led: polydeoxyribonucleotide sourced from purified DNA supports fibroblast activity and tissue repair, while glutathione and the vitamin C derivative 3-O-ethyl ascorbic acid provide antioxidant and melanin-modulating (brightening) action. Highly concentrated hyaluronic acid binds water in the dermis for hydration and plumping, and the combined actives help calm inflammation and normalise sebum for a clearer complexion.
composition: Polydeoxyribonucleotide (c-PDRN), Glutathione, Hyaluronic Acid (sodium hyaluronate), 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid (vitamin C derivative). Supplied as 2.5 mL ampoules.
usageNotes: For professional use via intradermal microinjection, mesotherapy, MTS/microneedling or as an adjunct to laser and RF. Typical protocol is 3-5 sessions at 1-2 week intervals with maintenance every 1-2 months. Single-use, sterile; store per manufacturer instructions in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and do not reuse opened ampoules.
features: c-PDRN combined with glutathione and vitamin C derivative in one vial
High-concentration hyaluronic acid for deep hydration
2.5 mL ampoule presentation for clinic workflows
Compatible with injection, MTS and energy-device protocols
benefits: Single-product solution reduces need to compound multiple actives
Addresses brightness, hydration and texture in one treatment line
Familiar multi-session protocol supports predictable repeat scheduling
Versatile delivery suits varied clinic device inventories
Recognisable brand for patient-facing enquiry-to-order catalogues

description: Curenex Snow Peel is a brightening-focused two-step skinbooster system from the Korean Curenex line (K Derma Co., Ltd.). It combines a lyophilised C-Tox powder with a Snow Peel activator so the practitioner reconstitutes a fresh cocktail that simultaneously exfoliates and biorevitalises. It is designed for tone correction, radiance and controlled surface renewal via mesotherapy or microneedling.
howItWorks: This is a combined brightening-peel and biorevitalisation product. The activator's gluconolactone (a PHA) provides gentle surface peeling and dead-cell turnover, while glutathione and niacinamide scavenge free radicals and modulate melanin synthesis to reduce pigmentation and even tone. Salmon-derived nucleic acids (PDRN), peptides, vitamins and hyaluronic acid support cellular repair, microcirculation and hydration in the treated dermis.
composition: C-Tox powder (purified hydrolysed sponge / nucleic acids) reconstituted with Snow Peel activator containing Gluconolactone, PDRN (salmon DNA), Multi-peptides, Glutathione, Niacinamide, Vitamins and Hyaluronic Acid. Presentation: powder vials plus activator (approx. 1 g x 4 vials, 5 vials per box).
usageNotes: Reconstitute the C-Tox powder with the activator immediately before treatment; use the mixed solution promptly and do not store reconstituted product. Apply via mesotherapy, MTS/microneedling or superficial dermal technique. Because a PHA peeling agent is included, advise post-care sun protection. Single-use and sterile; store components as directed away from heat and direct light.
features: Combines chemical peeling (PHA) with biorevitalisation in one protocol
PDRN, peptide, vitamin and HA support matrix
benefits: Dual peel-and-booster action in a single scheduled session
Targets pigmentation and dullness for brightening-led demand
Reconstitution model supports fresh, controlled dosing
Fits mesotherapy and microneedling clinic workflows
Part of an established Korean skinbooster brand family

description: Curenex Glow is a multi-component PDRN skinbooster from the Korean Curenex line (K Derma Co., Ltd.) that delivers a cocktail of regenerative, brightening and hydrating actives in one solution. It is built around salmon-derived PDRN combined with a large multi-peptide blend, glutathione and hyaluronic acid. The product targets overall rejuvenation, radiance and skin quality via mesotherapy, MTS or professional topical application.
howItWorks: PDRN is the lead active: polydeoxyribonucleotide fragments derived from salmon DNA support fibroblast proliferation and extracellular-matrix repair. Around fifteen multi-peptides signal collagen and elastin synthesis, glutathione provides antioxidant and brightening action, non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid drives hydration, and hydrolysed collagen and adenosine add further regenerative and soothing support - a cocktail approach that addresses repair, firmness, brightness and hydration together.
composition: PDRN (salmon DNA), ~15 multi-peptides, non-crosslinked Hyaluronic Acid (sodium hyaluronate), Glutathione, Hydrolysed Collagen, Adenosine. Presentation: 5 mL vials (5 vials per box).
usageNotes: For professional delivery via mesotherapy, MTS/microneedling or conical-applicator topical use between sessions. Typical course is 3-5 sessions spaced 2-3 weeks apart. Single-use, sterile; store as directed in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and use promptly once opened.
features: Non-crosslinked HA for hydration without volumising
Injectable or professional topical delivery options
benefits: Broad multi-target formula reduces need to layer products
Supports firmness, brightness and hydration in one line
Flexible delivery suits varied clinic protocols
Multi-vial box aligns with course-based selling
Established Curenex brand recognition for enquiry-to-order
indications: Overall facial rejuvenation and skin quality

description: REVS PRO 32 is a Korean bio-remodelling skinbooster (manufactured by Daon Medical Co., Ltd.) built on a high concentration of non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid. Each 2 mL syringe carries 64 mg of HA split evenly between high- and low-molecular-weight fractions, and it is frequently positioned as a 'Korean Profhilo'-style hydrator and skin-quality treatment. It hydrates, firms and bio-revitalises rather than adding volume.
howItWorks: The active is dual-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid in a non-BDDE, non-crosslinked format. High-molecular-weight HA provides scaffolding and slow, sustained hydration while low-molecular-weight HA disperses through multiple skin layers, together drawing and holding water and stimulating dermal remodelling. The gradual release supports improved hydration, firmness and elasticity across the treated area.
composition: Non-crosslinked Hyaluronic Acid 64 mg per 2 mL (32 mg high-molecular-weight + 32 mg low-molecular-weight), non-BDDE formulation. Presentation: 2 mL pre-filled syringe.
usageNotes: Administered by trained injectors using bolus/multi-point or micro-injection techniques (e.g. BAP-style placement). Single-use, sterile pre-filled syringe; store as directed at controlled room temperature away from direct sunlight and freezing, and do not reuse. Not a volumising filler - intended for hydration and bio-remodelling.
features: 64 mg HA per 2 mL in a dual-molecular-weight blend
Pre-filled 2 mL syringe for streamlined use
benefits: Positioned as a cost-effective alternative in the bio-remodelling category
Simple few-point technique supports efficient chair time
Pure HA profile appeals to hydration-focused patients
Pre-filled syringe reduces preparation steps
Clear single-active story for catalogue and enquiry
indications: Radiance and glow from improved hydration

description: Lapuroon Aurora Super is a high-strength PDRN skinbooster from the Korean Lapuroon Aurora line. It is built around a high concentration of PDRN (Sodium DNA) combined with hyaluronic acid and a broad support matrix of peptides, amino acids, vitamins and minerals. The 'Super' variant is positioned as the more concentrated, total-revitalising member of the range for regeneration, hydration and elasticity.
howItWorks: PDRN is the primary active: polydeoxyribonucleotide (sodium DNA) supports fibroblast activity, growth-factor signalling and extracellular-matrix repair for deep dermal regeneration. Hyaluronic acid manages hydration, multiple peptides and amino acids feed collagen and elastin synthesis, glutathione adds antioxidant/brightening action, and vitamins and minerals support cellular metabolism - a synergistic regenerative cocktail.
composition: PDRN (Sodium DNA, high concentration ~2%), Hyaluronic Acid (~1%), multiple Peptides, Amino Acids, Glutathione, Vitamins & Minerals, Retinol. Presentation: 2.5 mL syringes (2 per box).
usageNotes: For professional delivery by direct dermal injection, mesotherapy or MTS/microneedling, typically over a course of about 5 sessions at 3-4 week intervals. Single-use, sterile; store as directed away from heat and direct sunlight and use promptly once opened.
features: Peptide, amino-acid, vitamin and mineral support matrix
benefits: Concentrated regenerative profile for intensive protocols
Multi-active matrix targets repair, hydration and brightening together
Flexible injection or microneedling delivery
Course-based packaging supports repeat scheduling
Distinct 'Super' tier for premium menu positioning

description: Lapuroon Aurora Vivid is a PDRN skinbooster from the Korean Lapuroon Aurora line, formulated at a lighter PDRN concentration than the 'Super' variant for radiance and skin-quality work. It combines PDRN (Sodium DNA) with hyaluronic acid plus peptides, amino acids, vitamins, minerals, retinol and ascorbic acid. It targets hydration, brightening, elasticity and texture via injection, mesotherapy or microneedling.
howItWorks: PDRN leads the mechanism: polydeoxyribonucleotide fragments similar to human DNA promote tissue regeneration by stimulating growth factors and fibroblast activity in the dermis. Hyaluronic acid manages skin hydration, peptides and amino acids support collagen and elasticity, and ascorbic acid plus vitamins and minerals contribute antioxidant and brightening effects for radiant, refined skin.
composition: PDRN (Sodium DNA, ~0.2%), Hyaluronic Acid (~1%), Peptides, Amino Acids, Vitamins & Minerals, Retinol, Ascorbic Acid, Glutathione. Presentation: syringe format (Aurora line).
usageNotes: For professional use by direct dermal injection, mesotherapy or MTS/microneedling, typically as a course of 3-5 sessions every 3-4 weeks. Single-use, sterile; store as directed away from heat and direct light and use promptly once opened.
features: PDRN (Sodium DNA) at a lighter working concentration
benefits: Lighter PDRN tier suits entry and maintenance protocols
Radiance and brightening emphasis for glow-led demand
Multi-active cocktail simplifies the treatment menu
Pairs with the 'Super' variant for tiered offering
Recognisable Aurora branding for enquiry-to-order
indications: General revitalisation of dull or tired skin

description: AMI Eyes is a Korean polynucleotide (PN) skinbooster designed specifically for the delicate under-eye area and tear trough (manufactured by DKMC Korea Co., Ltd. and marketed under the AMI aesthetic range). It delivers a high-purity polynucleotide derived from salmon DNA to biostimulate the periorbital skin, offering a subtle refreshing effect without the lump or lymphatic-stagnation risk associated with volumising fillers. It is intended to address dark circles, texture and skin quality around the eyes.
howItWorks: The active is polynucleotide (PN), a purified and concentrated long-chain form of salmon-derived DNA fragments. Rather than filling space, PN stimulates the patient's own fibroblasts to regenerate the extracellular matrix and produce collagen and elastin, improving skin structure, thickness and texture. Supporting components (peptides and regenerative factors in some presentations) reinforce repair, refreshing tired, dull or thin under-eye skin.
composition: Polynucleotide (PN) ~1% (approx. 20 mg per 2 mL) derived from purified salmon DNA; some presentations list additional peptide and regenerative support components. Presentation: 2 mL pre-filled syringe.
usageNotes: For trained injectors using fine-needle micro-injection / mesotherapy technique in the periorbital and tear-trough area; superficial, low-volume placement to avoid lumps. Single-use, sterile pre-filled syringe; store as directed away from heat and direct sunlight and do not reuse. Typically delivered as a short course with maintenance.
features: Formulated specifically for the under-eye and tear-trough area
benefits: Dedicated periorbital product fills a specific menu gap
Addresses dark circles and thin under-eye skin without filler bulk
Regenerative positioning supports premium pricing
Pre-filled syringe streamlines delicate-area workflows
Part of a broader AMI PN range for cross-selling

description: Gemvous is a Korean injectable skinbooster (manufactured by SO YOUNG Co., Ltd., introduced around 2020) that combines polynucleotide with hyaluronic acid and niacinamide for a biorevitalising and brightening effect. It uses a polynucleotide (PN) platform derived from salmon DNA to restore and maintain skin elasticity while the niacinamide component adds a distinct tone-brightening action. It is used to improve deteriorated skin across the face and around the eyes.
howItWorks: Polynucleotide is the lead active: PN from salmon DNA promotes cellular regeneration, fibroblast activity and elasticity in the dermis. Hyaluronic acid provides hydration and rejuvenation, and the vitamin B3 component niacinamide brightens the upper dermis and evens tone by modulating pigment transfer and supporting the skin barrier - combining regeneration, hydration and brightening in one solution.
composition: Polynucleotide (PN, salmon DNA), Hyaluronic Acid, Niacinamide (vitamin B complex). Presentation: 2.5 cc vials/syringes (multi-unit boxes).
usageNotes: For professional delivery by dermal injection, mesotherapy or microneedling for deeper distribution. Single-use, sterile; store as directed away from heat and direct sunlight and use promptly once opened. Suitable for facial skin and periorbital use as directed.
benefits: Combines regeneration with a clear brightening angle
Single cocktail simplifies stock and protocols
Suits both facial and periorbital treatment demand
Flexible delivery for varied device inventories
Distinct brand for enquiry-to-order differentiation
indications: Biorevitalisation of deteriorated or tired skin

description: White Lumi is a Korean brightening / whitening skinbooster built on a peptide and antioxidant cocktail rather than a single active. It combines a multi-peptide complex with glutathione, hyaluronic acid, collagen, elastin, vitamins, amino acids and adenosine to target tone, radiance and skin support. It is used for topical and microneedling (mesotherapy-style) delivery to brighten and revitalise the skin. A specific manufacturer could not be independently verified.
howItWorks: This is a brightening-led peptide and antioxidant cocktail. Glutathione provides antioxidant action and modulates melanin synthesis for a lightening effect, while a blend of peptides signals repair and supports collagen and elastin. Hyaluronic acid, collagen and elastin components reinforce hydration and dermal structure, and vitamins, amino acids and adenosine add antioxidant and soothing support to improve overall radiance and tone.
composition: Core elements - Hyaluronic Acid, Collagen, Elastin; plus a nine-component complex: multi-peptides (including snake-venom and hibiscus peptide types and antibacterial peptides), Glutathione, Polymer Hyaluronic Acid, Mauritia flexuosa extract, Vitamins, Amino Acids, Adenosine.
usageNotes: For professional topical application and microneedling / MTS delivery per manufacturer guidance. Single-use, sterile; store as directed away from heat and direct sunlight and use promptly once opened. As a brightening cocktail, advise diligent post-procedure sun protection.
features: Glutathione as the core whitening active
HA, collagen and elastin structural support
benefits: Dedicated whitening/brightening option for tone-led demand
Multi-active cocktail reduces need to compound
Microneedling-friendly for lower-downtime protocols
Positions clearly within a brightening menu category
Cocktail format supports flexible session design
